args.title: Request window for December 2026 opens on 2 November
args.text:
Dear colleagues,

The request window for the December 2026 roster opens on 2 November 2026. Please submit your wishes for shifts and time off within this window.

Please note: wishes are inputs, not promises. They are considered when the roster is built, but they cannot be guaranteed. The final roster depends on department coverage and the rules on working time and rest periods.

Thank you for your cooperation.
